title: The subject participle
summary: Describe people and things by what they do with `-(y)An` (*kitap okuyan kız*), use participles as nouns (*gelenler*, *Türkçe bilen biri*), say **whose** (*babası doktor olan çocuk*), build long noun phrases in the right order, and learn the aorist participles of everyday words (*çalar saat*, *çıkmaz sokak*).
canDo: Point people out by what they are doing and how they look
Talk about those who came, won or took part
Say whose, and ask for a room with a view or a house with a garden
Read long noun phrases from the noun back
